description: Use for tourism in a Polish municipality, county or province: bed places per 1000 residents, nights spent, tourists, bed occupancy by month, and where short-term rental pressure is highest. Presja turystyczna finwire (finwire_tourism_pressure) from Statistics Poland (GUS BDL): bed places in tourist accommodation on 31 July per 1000 residents for Poland and each municipality with its rank; nights spent and tourists per year (Poland, provinces, counties, nights per resident), nights and bed occupancy rate per month (Poland, provinces). With q: municipalities matching the name, with the county nights per resident. GUS has no nights for municipalities after 2014.

q.description: Part of a municipality name, e.g. Zakopane; omit for Poland, provinces and the top municipalities.

name: get_tourism_pressure
title: Tourism pressure in Polish municipalities (finwire_tourism_pressure)
